stories.headline: Macron meets Pope Leo XIV at Vatican in first official audience
stories.summary: President Macron made his first official visit to Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican on April 10, discussing Middle East crisis and Lebanon situation. The hour-long private audience included gift exchanges, with Macron offering a French basketball jersey to the sports-loving American pope.

stories.headline: Lecornu announces major electrification plan with 10 billion euros budget

stories.headline: Labor unions oppose May 1st work law, threaten censure motion against Lecornu
stories.summary: Eight major unions wrote to PM Lecornu on April 12 demanding he not convene a joint committee that would fast-track a law allowing work on May 1st. Lecornu promised no 'forcing through' while PS leader Olivier Faure threatened a motion of censure if social dialogue is not respected.

stories.summary: LFI held its representative assembly on April 12 to prepare for 2027 presidential election, with Jean-Luc Mélenchon expected to announce his fourth presidential candidacy. The party is updating its program and organizing campaign structures while promoting its 'New France' concept.

stories.headline: Banque de France completes gold repatriation operation with major profits
stories.summary: The Banque de France completed repatriation of 129 tons of gold reserves from the US between July 2025 and January 2026, generating profits of nearly 13 billion euros. The operation involved selling older bars in New York and buying new ones in Europe during favorable market conditions.

stories.headline: RN mayors implement various local policy changes
stories.summary: Newly elected RN mayors across France took various actions including removing EU flags from town halls, increasing mayor salaries, canceling cultural events, and implementing local security measures. Actions reported in cities like Carcassonne, Montargis, La Flèche and others.

stories.headline: Élysée staff departures increase as Macron presidency nears end
stories.summary: A wave of departures from President Macron's Élysée staff has accelerated as his presidency approaches its 2027 end. At least ten advisors have left for more attractive positions in recent months, with the 2024 National Assembly dissolution limiting the presidency's domestic influence.

stories.headline: Macron prepares G7 summit and invites Trump to Versailles dinner
stories.summary: President Macron is preparing for the G7 summit to be held in Évian-les-Bains in June, with reports suggesting he invited US President Trump to a dinner at Château de Versailles. Trump has not yet confirmed his attendance at the summit.

stories.headline: Portrait of President Macron finally displayed in Cholet city hall
stories.summary: The new mayor of Cholet, Isabelle Leroy, has installed President Macron's official portrait in the city council chamber. The previous mayor, Gilles Bourdouleix, had refused to display it throughout Macron's presidency, breaking with tradition.

stories.headline: New Caledonia political consultations resume under Lecornu
stories.summary: Prime Minister Lecornu resumed direct involvement in New Caledonia affairs, holding meetings with both independence and non-independence representatives after his constitutional project was rejected. Multiple video conference sessions were held this week.
